title: Content plan - Inés (Spanish, psychologist) - 2026-11-23
summary: Inés should build a warm, expert voice of short, emotionally direct one-liners that tell her Spanish-speaking female audience their pain is not their fault and that they are allowed to protect themselves. Her plan leans on the proven formats (short statements, 'not your fault' messages, red flags, occasional credited quotes), keeps links out of posts, and uses a few personal reflection questions to invite replies. Every hypothesis from the research is tested across 2-4 posts over the 28-post window.

pillars.name: No es tu culpa (self-blame relief)
pillars.why: 'Te pasó porque había algo malo en esa persona, no en ti' reached 125,694 views and 1.8K likes, the top reach in the set.

pillars.name: Límites y permiso para irte
pillars.why: 'Nunca olvides que tienes libre albedrío. Y puedes irte...' drew 1.2K likes, and boundaries are central to Inés's theme.

pillars.name: Red flags y manipulación
pillars.why: 'Red flag 🚩' posts earned 1.5K likes and 62K views, and recognising manipulation is a core Inés topic.

pillars.name: Citas y reflexiones de autoridad
pillars.why: Quote posts average 2.6K reactions, the highest format, and the top post of the whole set is a quote (5.2K likes).

pillars.name: Amor propio y relaciones sanas
pillars.why: 'Querer a una persona también es trabajarte TÚ' (2.2K likes) and 'Sé exigente porque...' (2.4K likes) show strong demand for self-worth framing in relationships.

actions.title: Write one short 'no es tu culpa' statement weekly
actions.why: The top post 'Te pasó porque había algo malo en esa persona, no en ti' got 1.8K likes and 125,694 views; self-blame relief drives the most reactions in the set.
actions.how: Keep each one under 100 characters and make it about what happened to the reader, not what she did. Post one every week on the morning or main slot.

actions.title: Keep most posts under 100 characters
actions.why: Statement posts under 100 characters average 967 reactions versus 390 for 250-500 characters; @esmipsicologa's one-liners reach the highest views.
actions.how: Cut each draft to one central idea. If a second idea appears, move it to a separate post on another slot.

actions.title: Include one credited quote from an author weekly
actions.why: Quote posts average 2.6K reactions and the top post in the research is a quote with 5.2K likes (@esmipsicologa, Nedra Tawwab quote 3.6K).
actions.how: Quote a recognised psychologist or author with clear credit, then add one sentence of Inés's own reflection beneath it.

actions.title: Name red flags in concrete, recognisable terms
actions.why: 'Red flag 🚩: Sentir que tienes que esconder su conducta...' earned 1.5K likes and 62K views; specific signs build trust with this audience.
actions.how: Describe one specific behaviour the reader can recognise, starting with 'Red flag 🚩:'. Avoid diagnostic words.

actions.title: Give permission to leave without explaining
actions.why: 'Nunca olvides que tienes libre albedrío. Y puedes irte...' drew 1.2K likes and a 'Y puedes irte' structure is shown to resonate.
actions.how: Write a short line granting the right to leave a toxic situation, and add that no explanation is needed. Use it in roughly one post per week.

actions.title: Post 2-3 times a day as the schedule allows
actions.why: The plan fixes three slots per day; @esmipsicologa's audience engages most with consistent daily posting.
actions.how: Follow the fixed schedule and track reactions per slot to confirm whether the 21:30 main slot earns the most.

actions.title: Keep links out of posts entirely
actions.why: Posts with external links average 35 reactions versus several hundred for statements, the weakest format in the set.
actions.how: Remove URLs from all drafts. Point to the bio only if the account's link needs promoting.

actions.title: Ask one personal reflection question per week
actions.why: Questions average only 118 reactions versus 967 for short statements, so use them sparingly; @enric_corbera's 'when was the last time' style question drew replies.
actions.how: Use one short, personal question in the main 21:30 slot, not a generic 'what do you think?'.

posts.hook: Lo que te pasó no lo provocaste tú.
posts.draft: Lo que te pasó no lo provocaste tú. Pasó porque alguien decidió hacértelo, no porque tú fueras "demasiado".
posts.hook_en: What happened to you was not your doing.
posts.draft_en: What happened to you was not your doing. It happened because someone chose to do it to you, not because you were "too much."
posts.tests: not-your-fault messages raise reactions per 100 views
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - 'Te pasó porque había algo malo en esa persona, no en ti'
posts.why: Short self-blame relief line, the highest-reach pattern in the set.

posts.hook: Tres señales de que te están manipulando:
posts.draft:
Tres señales de que te están manipulando:
1. Te hacen dudar de lo que recuerdas.
2. Te piden que no cuentes lo que pasa "para no preocupar a nadie".
3. Te culpan de todo lo que sale mal.
¿Te suena alguna?
posts.hook_en: Three signs you are being manipulated:
posts.draft_en:
Three signs you are being manipulated:
1. They make you doubt what you remember.
2. They ask you not to tell anyone what happens "so no one worries."
3. They blame you for everything that goes wrong.
Does any of these sound familiar?
posts.cta: ¿Te suena alguna? Cuéntamelo en un comentario.
posts.tests: red flag posts earn more reactions than other topics
posts.why: Practical list of recognisable signs, a daytime format that teaches.

posts.hook_en: "You are not obliged to stay where you are not cared for."
posts.draft_en: "You are not obliged to stay where you are not cared for." And you don't have to explain why you're leaving.

posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - 'Nunca olvides que tienes libre albedrío. Y puedes irte.'

posts.topic: Señales de que tu esfuerzo no basta
posts.hook: Señales de que estás desviviéndote de más:
posts.draft:
Señales de que estás desviviéndote de más:
- Piensas en qué dirá la otra persona antes de hablar.
- Te disculpas aunque no hayas hecho nada.
- Das más de lo que recibes y te quedas con ganas.
Si te reconoces, no es debilidad. Es hora de poner un límite.
posts.hook_en: Signs you are over-giving:
posts.draft_en:
Signs you are over-giving:
- You think about what the other person will say before you speak.
- You apologise even when you haven't done anything wrong.
- You give more than you receive and are left wanting.
If you recognise yourself, it is not weakness. It is time to set a limit.
posts.why: Daytime practical list that names over-giving, a pattern from the top posts.

posts.hook: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz al lado de alguien?
posts.draft: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz al lado de alguien? Cuéntamelo, sin prisa.
posts.hook_en: When was the last time you felt at peace next to someone?
posts.draft_en: When was the last time you felt at peace next to someone? Tell me, no rush.
posts.cta: Cuéntamelo sin prisa en los comentarios.
posts.tests: a single personal question invites more replies than generic questions
posts.why: Main-slot personal question that is easy to answer.

posts.hook: Dejar de culparte no es olvidar. Es dejar de cargar con algo que no te pertenece.
posts.draft: Dejar de culparte no es olvidar. Es dejar de cargar con algo que no te pertenece.
posts.hook_en: Stopping self-blame is not forgetting. It is putting down something that was never yours to carry.
posts.draft_en: Stopping self-blame is not forgetting. It is putting down something that was never yours to carry.
posts.tests: not-your-fault messages raise reactions per 100 views

posts.hook: Cómo distinguir que te entienden de que te manipulan:
posts.draft:
Cómo distinguir que te entienden de que te manipulan:
- Quien te entiende te deja decidir.
- Quien te manipula te hace sentir culpable por decidir.
- Quien te entiende te escucha sin amenazarte con irse.
El cariño no da miedo.
posts.hook_en: How to tell being understood from being manipulated:
posts.draft_en:
How to tell being understood from being manipulated:
- Someone who understands you lets you decide.
- Someone who manipulates you makes you feel guilty for deciding.
- Someone who understands you listens without threatening to leave.
Affection does not make you afraid.
posts.tests: red flag posts earn more reactions than other topics
posts.why: Practical comparison that helps readers name what they feel.

posts.hook: Puedes marcharte cuando quieras, de verdad.
posts.draft: Tienes derecho a marcharte cuando algo te hace daño. Puedes dejar la mesa, tomar distancia de quien te lastima y empezar otra vez cuando te sientas lista.
posts.hook_en: You can leave whenever you want, really.
posts.draft_en: You have the right to leave when something hurts you. You can walk away from the table, step back from whoever harms you, and start again when you feel ready.
posts.tests: permission-to-leave earns high reactions
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - 'Puedes irte. Y levantarte de esa mesa.' (1.2K likes)
posts.why: Evening main slot with strong permission message and a reply prompt. (rewritten: the first draft was too close to a competitor post)

posts.draft: Observa lo que la gente hace y no te quedes solo con lo que dice. Sus actos te van a contar la verdad desde el primer encuentro.
posts.hook_en: Watch what people do, not what they promise.
posts.draft_en: Watch what people do and do not stick only to what they say. Their actions will tell you the truth from the first encounter.
posts.tests: quote posts reach more views than other formats
posts.why: Short quoted line with a reflection, morning-safe and quotable. (rewritten: the first draft was too close to a competitor post)

posts.topic: Señales de alarma en la pareja
posts.hook: Tres señales de alarma que no conviene ignorar:
posts.draft:
Tres señales de alarma que no conviene ignorar:
1. Te hace sentir que siempre tienes que pedir perdón.
2. Controla a quién ves o con quién hablas.
3. Cambia de humor y tú vas con cuidado para no molestarle.
Si te suenan, no estás exagerando.
posts.hook_en: Three warning signs not to ignore:
posts.draft_en:
Three warning signs not to ignore:
1. They make you feel you always have to apologise.
2. They control who you see or talk to.
3. Their mood shifts and you walk on eggshells to avoid upsetting them.
If these sound familiar, you are not overreacting.
posts.tests: red flag posts earn more reactions than other topics
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - red flag post with concrete signs
posts.why: Practical daytime list of recognisable warning signs.

posts.draft_en: Red flag: Always being your fault, even when you don't know why.

posts.hook: Si te cuesta no volver con esa persona, prueba esto:
posts.draft:
Si te cuesta no volver con esa persona, prueba esto:
- Escribe lo que sentiste en los peores momentos.
- Recuerda por qué te fuiste, no solo cómo te sentías al final.
- Habla con alguien de confianza antes de decidir.
No tienes que hacerlo todo hoy.
posts.hook_en: If it's hard not to go back to that person, try this:
posts.draft_en:
If it's hard not to go back to that person, try this:
- Write down what you felt in the worst moments.
- Remember why you left, not only how you felt at the end.
- Talk to someone you trust before deciding.
You don't have to do it all today.
posts.why: Daytime practical tips for a common breakup struggle.

posts.draft_en: Healing is not forgetting, it is no longer living on alert for the person who hurt you. I hope you are already getting there today.

posts.topic: Señales de que te están manipulando
posts.hook: Señales de que te están manipulando, aunque no lo parezca:
posts.draft:
Señales de que te están manipulando, aunque no lo parezca:

Te hacen sentir culpable por cosas que no hiciste.
Cambian la versión de lo que pasó y te dejan dudando de tu memoria.
Te piden que no cuentes lo que pasa "para no preocupar a nadie".

Si te suena, no estás exagerando. Confía en lo que sientes.
posts.hook_en: Signs you are being manipulated, even if it doesn't look like it:
posts.draft_en:
Signs you are being manipulated, even if it doesn't look like it:

They make you feel guilty for things you didn't do.
They change the version of what happened and leave you doubting your memory.
They ask you not to tell anyone "so no one worries."

If this sounds familiar, you are not exaggerating. Trust what you feel.
posts.cta: ¿Cuál de estas te ha pasado a ti?
posts.tests: Short statements and red flag format; no links
posts.why: Concrete, recognizable signs in a short list build trust and invite self-recognition.

posts.topic: Dejar de culparte por quedarte tanto tiempo
posts.hook: ¿Cuántas veces te has preguntado por qué te quedaste tanto tiempo?
posts.draft:
¿Cuántas veces te has preguntado por qué te quedaste tanto tiempo?

Quedarte no te hace débil. Te quedaste porque tenías esperanza, porque te querías, porque alguien te hizo creer que podía cambiar.

No necesitas una respuesta perfecta para merecer compasión.
posts.hook_en: How many times have you asked yourself why you stayed so long?
posts.draft_en:
How many times have you asked yourself why you stayed so long?

Staying doesn't make you weak. You stayed because you had hope, because you cared, because someone made you believe they could change.

You don't need a perfect answer to deserve compassion.
posts.cta: Cuéntame, ¿qué te hizo quedarte? Puedes responder con una sola palabra.
posts.tests: Question format sparingly; not your fault message
posts.why: A personal reflective question paired with relief from self-blame invites replies without being generic.

posts.hook: Tranquila. Descansar también es cuidarte.
posts.draft: Tranquila. Descansar también es cuidarte.

posts.draft_en: Relax. Resting is also taking care of yourself.

posts.hook: Poner un límite no es ser cruel. Empieza por algo pequeño:
posts.draft:
Poner un límite no es ser cruel. Empieza por algo pequeño:

Di "no puedo hoy" sin dar diez excusas.
No contestes un mensaje que te hace daño hasta que estés en calma.

posts.hook_en: Setting a limit is not being cruel. Start with something small:
posts.draft_en:
Setting a limit is not being cruel. Start with something small:

Say "I can't today" without giving ten excuses.
Don't reply to a message that hurts you until you're calm.
Ask for what you need without apologizing three times.

Boundaries are practiced too.
posts.cta: ¿Qué límite te está costando más poner ahora?
posts.tests: Short list format; no links
posts.why: Concrete, easy-to-apply steps are the practical format that suits the daytime slot.

posts.hook: No puedes cambiar a quien no quiere verse.
posts.draft: Antes de agotarte para que la relación funcione, ten esto presente: no puedes transformar el comportamiento de quien no reconoce que hay algo que cambiar. El amor solo no basta si la otra persona no quiere mirarse.
posts.hook_en: You cannot change someone who does not want to see themselves.
posts.draft_en: Before you exhaust yourself trying to make it work, keep this in mind: you cannot change the behavior of someone who sees no problem with it. Love alone is not enough when the other person refuses to look.
posts.tests: Short statements under 100 characters; 'not your fault' messages
posts.why: Adapts a proven over-giving hook into a short, clear insight about effort that doesn't work. (rewritten: the first draft was too close to a competitor post)

"Deja que la gente te muestre quién es."

No hace falta adivinarlo ni justificarlo. Lo que hace la gente una y otra vez te dice más que cualquier promesa.
posts.hook_en: "Let people show you who they are."
posts.draft_en:
"Let people show you who they are."

You don't have to guess or justify it. What people do again and again tells you more than any promise.

posts.draft: No estás obligada a quedarte donde no te cuidan. Y tampoco tienes que explicar por qué te vas.
posts.hook_en: You are not obliged to stay where you are not cared for.
posts.draft_en: You are not obliged to stay where you are not cared for. And you don't have to explain why you're leaving.
posts.tests: Permission to leave; short statements
posts.why: Permission to leave without justification is one of the strongest emotional promises in the set.

posts.hook: Tranquila. Tu forma de sobrevivir no te define.
posts.draft: Tranquila. Tu forma de sobrevivir no te define.
posts.hook_en: Relax. The way you survived does not define you.
posts.draft_en: Relax. The way you survived does not define you.
posts.tests: Short self-compassion lines
posts.why: A two-sentence self-compassion line with a closing word mirrors the proven survival-mode pattern.

posts.topic: Red flag: aislarte de tus amigas
posts.hook: Red flag 🚩: que te hagan sentir que tus amigas no te entienden.
posts.draft: Red flag 🚩: que te hagan sentir que tus amigas no te entienden. Cuando alguien quiere que estés sola con él, empieza por desconfiar de tu red.
posts.hook_en: Red flag: they make you feel your friends don't understand you.
posts.draft_en: Red flag: they make you feel your friends don't understand you. When someone wants you alone with them, they start by distrusting your circle.
posts.tests: Red flag format with concrete recognisable sign
posts.why: A specific, recognisable red flag in the proven format.

posts.topic: Lo que aprendiste de tu mejor relación
posts.hook: ¿Qué aprendiste de tu mejor relación, aunque ya no esté?
posts.draft:
¿Qué aprendiste de tu mejor relación, aunque ya no esté?

A veces lo que más nos cuesta es reconocer lo bueno que nos dejó. Esa parte también te pertenece.
posts.hook_en: What did you learn from your best relationship, even though it's over?
posts.draft_en:
What did you learn from your best relationship, even though it's over?

Sometimes the hardest part is recognizing the good it left us. That part belongs to you too.
posts.cta: Cuéntame en una frase qué te dejó.
posts.tests: Personal reflective question; testing questions sparingly
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - reflection on what a healthy relationship taught
posts.why: A single personal question invites easy replies, as the audience asked for in the comments.

posts.hook: Nunca es tarde para empezar a construir algo tuyo.
posts.draft: Todavía tienes tiempo para armar una vida que te guste. Sin correr. Un pasito cada día.
posts.hook_en: It is never too late to start building something of your own.
posts.draft_en: You still have time to build a life you love. No rush. One small step each day.
posts.tests: Warm short statements in the morning
posts.why: Gentle reassurance in the morning slot, short and comforting. (rewritten: the first draft was too close to a competitor post)

posts.topic: Señales de que tu esfuerzo no basta
posts.hook: Señales de que tu esfuerzo ya no está funcionando:
posts.draft:
Señales de que tu esfuerzo ya no está funcionando:

Siempre eres tú quien pide disculpas.
Lo que necesitas se queda para "después".
Sales de cada conversación con más dudas que claridad.

Si reconoces alguna, no es que te falte esfuerzo. Es hora de revisar la relación.
posts.hook_en: Signs your effort is no longer working:
posts.draft_en:
Signs your effort is no longer working:

You're always the one who apologizes.
What you need is always left for "later."
You leave every conversation with more doubts than clarity.

If you recognize any of these, it's not that you lack effort. It's time to review the relationship.
posts.tests: Practical list format on daytime slot
posts.why: A clear, practical list of signs in the daytime slot invites recognition.

posts.topic: Padres que te cuidan como adulta
posts.hook: Puede doler lo que te dieron y lo que no.
posts.draft: Si tus padres te quieren y te cuidan siendo adulta, es algo valioso. Y si no es tu caso, también es normal sentir esa carencia. Las dos cosas pueden ser ciertas a la vez.
posts.hook_en: What they gave you and what they did not can both hurt.
posts.draft_en: If your parents love you and take care of you as an adult, that is something precious. And if that is not your situation, it is also normal to feel that lack. Both things can be true at once.
posts.cta: ¿Cómo ha sido tu relación con tu familia de adulta?
posts.tests: Credited quote from a respected author with own reflection
posts.why: A credited quote from a recognised author, paired with a reflection, tests the quote-format lift. (rewritten: the first draft was too close to a competitor post)
